thread:
maya: Heads up — planning a 3-day X/LinkedIn burst around the launch next Tue (May 5). Need: hero image, 3 caption variations (short/promo/benchmark), webinar CTA, UTM params, and inbound lead routing tags. Who can own assets + scheduling?
liam: I can own hero + alt images. Need exact sizes for X (1200x675?) and LI (1200x627?). Confirm.
natalie: Copy options — I'll draft 3 variants: TL;DR, Benchmark angle, Product-first. Will drop in the doc by EOD Fri. @maya do we want the benchmark narrative to surface CPU/GPU cost numbers?
maya: Yes — highlight '2–3x lower inference cost' from Optimize bench but avoid exact $ unless legal approves. Use 'up to' phrasing.
sam: I can handle scheduling. Where do we want to queue? Buffer or native sched? Also need webinar link + registration UTM.
oliver: I'll set routing: tag inbound leads as 'launch-x' and 'launch-li'. Add form field 'use_case' so SDRs can triage. Who owns the hub landing page?
maya: Product owns the landing, but webinar registration is with @paige. @paige can you share the registration link (and confirm UTM values)?
paige: Sharing link: https://redwood.ai/webinar-launch?utm_source=social&utm_campaign=launch_q2
UTM: social / launch_q2 / post. Webinar hosted May 6 11am PT. I'll confirm registration fields include 'company' + 'use_case'.
natalie: For the thread posts, propose schedule:
  - Day 1 AM: Teaser (short)
  - Day 1 PM: Benchmark highlight + screenshot
  - Day 2 AM: Webinar CTA
  - Day 3: Customer quote + link
Will paste caption variants.
maya: Perfect. Also we need engagement play: 2 people to monitor first 4 hours after each post and reply to questions + DM leads. @sam can you set rota?
sam: Yep — I'll create a Slack rota in #marketing and pick 2 people per slot. Suggest: @liam, @natalie, @oliver, @maya.
natalie: :thumbsup: include quick reply templates. I'll draft 4: webinar, product details, pricing, demo request.
engage-bot: Reminder: schedule checklist missing asset 'benchmark-carousel.png' and 'short-caption-3'. Upload to /marketing/assets by Fri 12pm.
liam: Uploading hero and carousel now. Filenames:
  - hero-launch-1200x675.png
  - benchmark-carousel-1.png
  - benchmark-carousel-2.png
paige: Added registration field 'use_case'. Confirmed GDPR check done.
oliver: Routing rules (draft):
  - inbound leads with 'interested' tag -> create ticket in SFDC queue 'MKT-Launch'
  - webinar signups -> notify SDRs channel and create daily digest
  - urgent MQLs (company_size>100 & exec title) -> immediate ping to sales-oncall
maya: Awesome. Last ask: can we shorten the X captions to <=280 chars and include a shortened CTA link. @natalie will add short links.
natalie: Working on them. Will post final assets + copy to the thread when ready.
maya: Thanks all! I'll assemble the schedule doc and publish in #marketing-schedule. :rocket:
